target_year_over_year_context.explanation: The 2025 disclosure (D028) describes the 'Application Development and Data Services Portfolio' under Tanzu, specifically mentioning an 'AI application development platform' and 'low-latency, real-time data' capabilities. This directly corresponds to the 2024 disclosures: D033 (general Tanzu application development/ops), D034 (Tanzu Platform for application development/operations and Tanzu AI Solutions), and D035 (Tanzu Data for data services/real-time transactions). Both sets describe the same underlying software portfolio components for app dev and data management within the Infrastructure Software section.

materiality_analysis.reason: This is a structural consolidation (merge) of three disclosures into one. The 2025 text summarizes the 'Application Development and Data Services Portfolio' and 'Tanzu AI Solutions' into a cohesive narrative. While specific details about Tanzu Platform governance and Tanzu Data warehouse capabilities are summarized, the core business activity (providing app dev and data services) is unchanged. The shift to highlighting 'AI application development' as a central theme is consistent with existing Tanzu AI Solutions disclosure and reflects a marketing emphasis rather than a new strategic pivot.
